# Dalberg

> Dalberg is a global consulting firm dedicated to building inclusive and sustainable solutions across emerging markets in Africa, Asia, and beyond.

Dalberg operates through four integrated service divisions—Advisors, Data Insights, Design, and Research—delivering strategic advisory, AI-powered solutions, human-centered design, and market analysis. The firm is structured as the Dalberg Trust, an organizational model that protects its mission-driven approach while maintaining governance across offices in Kenya, India, Mexico, the United States, Europe, and the Middle East.
